nodes.label: DLT registration for a custom SMS Sender ID
nodes.rationale: Register as a Principal Entity on a telecom DLT platform, register a Sender ID under the Others/Service header category (not Promotional, and not Transactional unless it is a bank's own banking transaction), register the exact content template, then hand PE ID / Header / Header ID / Template ID to Eko during onboarding. Sender IDs are case-sensitive.
